name: 다계층 DNS 기본 해석 및 캐시 계층별 전파(APP/OS/ISP/AUTH)
input:
SET_AUTH_RECORD domain=api.zeli.com type=A value=10.0.0.1 ttl=60
RESOLVE api.zeli.com
RESOLVE api.zeli.com
STATUS api.zeli.com
output:
SET_AUTH_RECORD_OK domain=api.zeli.com value=10.0.0.1 ttl=60
RESOLVED api.zeli.com 10.0.0.1 source=AUTHORITATIVE ttl=60
RESOLVED api.zeli.com 10.0.0.1 source=APP_CACHE ttl=30
--- DNS_STATUS api.zeli.com ---
APP: 10.0.0.1 (ttl=30)
OS: 10.0.0.1 (ttl=60)
ISP: 10.0.0.1 (ttl=60)
AUTH: 10.0.0.1 (ttl=60)
--- END_STATUS ---

name: 시간 경과(TICK)에 따른 단계적 캐시 만료 및 하위 계층 폴백
input:
SET_AUTH_RECORD domain=web.zeli.com type=A value=10.1.1.1 ttl=60
RESOLVE web.zeli.com
TICK 30
RESOLVE web.zeli.com
STATUS web.zeli.com
TICK 30

output:

RESOLVED web.zeli.com 10.1.1.1 source=OS_CACHE ttl=30

RESOLVED web.zeli.com 10.1.1.1 source=AUTHORITATIVE ttl=60

name: JVM -1 영구 캐싱(Forever Pinning) 좀비 트래픽 참사와 앱 캐시 플러시
input:
CONFIG_APP ttl=-1 negative_ttl=10
SET_AUTH_RECORD domain=service.zeli.com type=A value=10.0.0.1 ttl=60
RESOLVE service.zeli.com
SET_AUTH_RECORD domain=service.zeli.com type=A value=10.0.0.2 ttl=60
TICK 3600
RESOLVE service.zeli.com
STATUS service.zeli.com
FLUSH_CACHE target=APP
RESOLVE service.zeli.com
output:
CONFIG_APP_OK ttl=-1 negative_ttl=10
SET_AUTH_RECORD_OK domain=service.zeli.com value=10.0.0.1 ttl=60
RESOLVED service.zeli.com 10.0.0.1 source=AUTHORITATIVE ttl=60
SET_AUTH_RECORD_OK domain=service.zeli.com value=10.0.0.2 ttl=60
TICK_OK elapsed=3600
RESOLVED service.zeli.com 10.0.0.1 source=APP_CACHE ttl=-1
--- DNS_STATUS service.zeli.com ---
APP: 10.0.0.1 (ttl=-1)
OS: MISS
ISP: MISS
AUTH: 10.0.0.2 (ttl=60)
--- END_STATUS ---
FLUSH_OK target=APP
RESOLVED service.zeli.com 10.0.0.2 source=AUTHORITATIVE ttl=60

name: ISP의 최소 TTL 강제(min_ttl_clamp)와 구 IP 잔류 현상

name: RFC 2308 네거티브 캐싱(NXDOMAIN)과 신규 레코드 전파 차단
input:
SET_AUTH_SOA domain=newservice.zeli.com negative_ttl=40
RESOLVE newservice.zeli.com
SET_AUTH_RECORD domain=newservice.zeli.com type=A value=172.16.0.5 ttl=120
TICK 5
RESOLVE newservice.zeli.com
STATUS newservice.zeli.com
TICK 6
RESOLVE newservice.zeli.com
FLUSH_CACHE target=ALL
RESOLVE newservice.zeli.com
output:
SET_AUTH_SOA_OK domain=newservice.zeli.com negative_ttl=40
RESOLVED newservice.zeli.com NXDOMAIN source=AUTHORITATIVE_NXDOMAIN ttl=40
SET_AUTH_RECORD_OK domain=newservice.zeli.com value=172.16.0.5 ttl=120
TICK_OK elapsed=5
RESOLVED newservice.zeli.com NXDOMAIN source=APP_CACHE ttl=5
--- DNS_STATUS newservice.zeli.com ---
APP: NXDOMAIN (ttl=5)
OS: NXDOMAIN (ttl=35)
ISP: NXDOMAIN (ttl=35)
AUTH: 172.16.0.5 (ttl=120)
--- END_STATUS ---
TICK_OK elapsed=6
RESOLVED newservice.zeli.com NXDOMAIN source=OS_CACHE ttl=29
FLUSH_OK target=ALL
RESOLVED newservice.zeli.com 172.16.0.5 source=AUTHORITATIVE ttl=120
